edges.name: cli-server
edges.reason: the CLI reaches the server only through the contract; only its e2e tests and test helpers start the real server

edges.name: pepys
edges.reason: no module and no lib imports @boxxy/pepys; an app passes its sink and reader in through the ports

modules.name: sqlite
modules.reason: only adapters/store-sqlite opens the store, and only adapters/auth-oauth opens the auth database; use the ClaimStore or the public door

modules.name: oauth
modules.reason: only adapters/auth-oauth runs the OAuth server and its passkeys; take its public door

modules.name: atc
modules.reason: only adapters/worker-atc talks to atc; use its WorkerKind

modules.name: imp-identity
modules.reason: only adapters/caller-proof-imp verifies the imp identity token; take its CallerProof

modules.name: noslop
modules.reason: only adapters/review-noslop checks and posts a review result; take its ReviewGate

modules.name: pepys-kit
modules.reason: only packages/pepys binds to the pepys kit; take its sink and reader through the ports

modules.name: wringer
modules.reason: only the CLI's tests and test helpers build the verify CLI; the registry lives in apps/cli/src/test-utils/verify/

modules.name: github-app
modules.reason: only adapters/forge-github mints the boxxy App's installation token; take createGithubAppAuth

modules.name: wringer-core
modules.reason: the CLI's tests and test helpers build the verify CLI on it, and only adapters/verifier-wringer reads its report for the server; take the Verifier port

modules.name: yaml
modules.reason: only modules/rules parses YAML; load a rules checkout with its loadRules

modules.name: liquid
modules.reason: only libs/prompt-template parses and renders a launch prompt; use its findPromptTemplateFault and renderPromptTemplate

modules.name: xstate
modules.reason: only modules/dispatch runs the attempt machine; build attempt writes with its buildAttemptChange

modules.name: domain-io
modules.reason: a module or a lib does no I/O; take an adapter through a port

globals.name: network
globals.reason: only an adapter, or a package that another repo installs, calls an outside system

unresolved.name: unresolved
unresolved.reason: a package imports another only through the entries its exports list

no-restricted-globals.name: Date
no-restricted-globals.message: Take the time as an argument.

no-restricted-globals.name: Bun
no-restricted-globals.message: A module or a lib does no I/O; take an adapter through a port.

patterns.message: The planning core never names a concept; read plug-ins from the loaded rules.
